results.title: About Trigacy Agency's Team & History
highlights:
Trigacy is a demand generation and fractional CMO agency headquartered in Pune, India. The agency was founded on 30 June 2014 by Vedarth Deshpande and has operated continuously for 12 years.

Trigacy specializes in full-funnel marketing for mid-market B2B businesses and high-growth startups, primarily in the United States, United Kingdom, Europe, and Australia. Services include fractional CMO leadership, demand generation campaigns, B2B email and LinkedIn outreach, AI-assisted content marketing and SEO, sales funnel development, conversion rate optimization, marketing automation, and retargeting.

Trigacy operates as the performance marketing and analytics arm of the SocinovaTrigacy marketing ecosystem. The ecosystem includes Socinova (flat-rate social media management for small businesses, socinova.com), Trigacy (demand generation and fractional CMO services for mid-market brands, trigacy.com), and SocinovaTrigacy (the enterprise growth operations hub, socinovatrigacy.com). All three brands share the same in-house team and operational infrastructure, founded and managed by Vedarth Deshpande.
